title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 6: restoring what was taken, and the laws of the burnt offering, the meal offering and the sin offering.

questions.text: Which of these is listed as a way of dealing falsely with a neighbor?
questions.explanation: The list includes a matter of deposit, bargain or robbery, oppressing a neighbor, and finding something lost and lying about it.

answers.text: Finding something lost and lying about it
Working on the Sabbath day
Eating fat or blood
Touching an unclean carcass

questions.text: When was the guilty person to return what he had taken, with a fifth part added?
questions.explanation: He shall restore it in full, add a fifth part more, and return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

answers.text: After seven full days had passed
In the day of his being found guilty
At the end of the year
Whenever the owner came and asked for it

questions.text: How long was the burnt offering to stay on the hearth on the altar?
questions.explanation: The burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning.

answers.text: Until the sun went down
For three days
All night until the morning
Only until the fat was burned

questions.text: What did the priest put on to remove the ashes from the altar?
questions.explanation: The priest shall put on his linen garment and his linen trousers, and remove the ashes.

answers.text: The robe of blue with bells
The ephod and the breastplate
Sackcloth
His linen garment and linen trousers

questions.text: What did the priest do before carrying the ashes outside the camp?
questions.explanation: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

answers.text: He washed his hands and feet in the basin
He took off his garments and put on other garments
He burned incense on the golden altar
He waited until evening and then washed his clothes

questions.text: How often did the priest burn wood on the altar fire?
questions.explanation: The fire on the altar shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning.

answers.text: Every morning
Every Sabbath
Once a month
Only on feast days

questions.text: Where were Aaron and his sons to eat what was left of the meal offering?
questions.explanation: It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: Each in his own tent, with his family
Outside the camp
At the gate of the court
In the court of the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: How was the tenth of an ephah of fine flour offered by Aaron and his sons to be divided?
questions.explanation: It was one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

answers.text: All of it together at noon
One third at each of three meals
Half in the morning and half in the evening
Half on the Sabbath and half on the new moon

questions.text: What was to happen to every meal offering of a priest?
questions.explanation: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.

answers.text: It was wholly burned and not eaten
It was eaten by the priest's family
It was given to the poor
It was eaten by the Levites

questions.text: What was to be done with an earthen vessel in which a sin offering was boiled?
questions.explanation: The earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; a bronze vessel shall be scoured and rinsed in water.

answers.text: It was to be buried in the ground
It was to be broken
It was to be given to the Levites
It was to be kept in the holy place
